### Atmus Filtration Technologies Releases Annual Sustainability Report


September 17, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/258697686/files/doc_news/Atmus-Filtration-Technologies-Releases-Annual-Sustainability-Report-2026.pdf)


NASHVILLE, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (Atmus; NYSE: ATMU) (“Atmus”), a global leader in filtration and media solutions, today released its 2025 Sustainability Report. This second annual report showcases how Atmus is creating a better future by protecting what is important.


“As a global company, we know it is a responsibility and privilege to influence and shape a sustainable future,” said Steph Disher, Chief Executive Officer and President of Atmus. “We are happy to share our progress in protecting our people, our customers and our planet.”


The company’s 2025 Sustainability Report details how Atmus protects what is important to global business and the energy transition through science that safeguards, authentic sustainability and people-led leadership. Key topics covered include:


- Our People: Employee health, safety and wellbeing; inclusion and diversity of perspective; talent attraction, retention, development and training.
- Our Planet: Emissions reduction; operational resources usage; product design and quality; sustainable supply chain.
- Our Principles: Corporate governance; ethics and compliance; data privacy and cybersecurity.


In addition, the report spotlights key initiatives such as Atmus’ Safety Pledge campaign and the “Design for Sustainability Standard” engineering process. Both projects launched in 2025 and are already generating results.


Following its acquisition of Koch Filter Corporation earlier this year, Atmus is continuing to expand its sustainability efforts across its growing enterprise. “Our business growth allows us to make an even bigger impact on protecting what is important, which, in turn, drives additional business growth,” said Jack Kienzler, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer at Atmus. “We look forward to reporting on our progress in next year’s report.”


Read the full[2025 Sustainability Report](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fatmus.com%2Fsites%2Fdefault%2Ffiles%2F2026-09%2F2025-Atmus-Sustainability-Report_Final.pdf&esheet=54605676&newsitemid=20260917392524&lan=en-US&anchor=2025+Sustainability+Report&index=1&md5=54d5c00a381a2bbe572c251ece6bf3ba)


**About Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc.**


Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (Atmus; NYSE: ATMU) is a global leader in filtration and media solutions. With more than 65 years of innovation and engineering expertise to deliver high-performance filtration solutions, Atmus operates through two business segments: Power Solutions, which serves global on- and off-highway equipment markets through its trusted Fleetguard® brand; and Industrial Solutions, which addresses commercial and industrial HVAC applications, and high- growth end markets including data centers and power generation environments – through its dependable Koch Filter® brand. Headquartered in Nashville, Tenn., Atmus employs nearly 5,000 people worldwide who are committed to creating a better future by protecting what is important. Learn more at[https://www.atmus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.atmus.com&esheet=54605676&newsitemid=20260917392524&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.atmus.com&index=2&md5=cf18bd053d70994507f62395707df4a0) .
